pages.title: Elemental Attack
pages.text: Pops three parameters: target entity (Entity), attack power (double), element type (ElementType).

Order doesn't matter, automatically recognized. Deals corresponding elemental damage to the target and applies elemental attachment, may trigger elemental reactions.

Base damage = power × (8~12) depending on element.
Mana cost = (24 + power)^(1 + power/10)

pages.title: Fire
pages.text:
Base damage: 12×power
Reactions: Overload (+Lightning), Neutralize (+Water), Cancel (+Ice), Combust (+Wind), Spread (Wind+Fire)

pages.title: Water
pages.text:
Base damage: 8×power
Reactions: Electrocute (+Lightning), Neutralize (+Fire), Freeze (+Ice), Void Erosion (+End)

pages.title: Ice
pages.text:
Base damage: 12×power
Reactions: Freeze (+Water), Cancel (+Fire), Cold Wind (+Wind), Spread (Wind+Ice)

pages.title: Wind
pages.text:
Base damage: 9×power
Reactions: Combust (+Fire), Spread (+Fire/Ice/Water), Cold Wind (+Ice)
